statusDefinitions.covered: An existing executable Phoenix row directly checks the archived behavior named by the source test.
statusDefinitions.partial: An executable row covers a narrower or synthetic seam; closure remains explicitly stated.
statusDefinitions.missing: No executable row currently checks the named behavior; closure is a concrete feature or fixture requirement.
statusDefinitions.supporting: A top-level test helper counted by the source inventory; its assertions are exercised by the named callers.
statusDefinitions.skipped: The archived test is explicitly skipped and has no required replay.
statusDefinitions.excluded: The archived test targets a debug/developer-only route outside Phoenix product scope and is intentionally accepted without implementation.

mappingRules: Rows are one per archived named test_* definition counted by the 136-test inventory; the two test_* helpers in test_bing.py are marked supporting and are not standalone unittest cases.
A target may be reused when one Phoenix matrix row genuinely exercises several archived cases; reuse does not create additional coverage rows.
The 28 answer and 12 async rows are source-shaped controls; provider outputs are synthetic unless a target explicitly names a pinned adapter body.
News source cases are counted as 10 archived cases and 14 local test blocks in the existing receipt; this map does not convert the 14 blocks into 14 source cases.
Live integration inputs and live provider assertions without output goldens remain partial or missing even when a local adapter seam exists.
Wikipedia decision-matrix rows use injected page JSON and source-derived summaries; they cover deterministic gate/title/normalization decisions and do not claim current/live article output.

The three archived Wikipedia named-case rows use the immutable mocked_wikipedia summaries or constructor error from tests/unit/test_pegasus.py and tests/unit/test_wikipedia.py; the provider is reached through a question-shaped wrapper that preserves each source strict query, and no current/live article body is claimed.

The blocked-dictionary row pins all 344 archived output words and replays them against the matcher; it remains partial until the full word-list/words.txt corpus is available through the allowed source surface.

The integrated /structQA candidate covers the archived no-input and absent/wrong Intent envelopes; the standalone GQA service also covers the source healthcheck and developer /fakeAccount helper without registering either route in Classic; the Bing Cortana row is partial because its deterministic Entities carousel decode is covered while its live roster text/order has no immutable golden.
